g.text: Ticket Execution — Local Slice Loop and Independent Function Verification
Clean context + scoped contract; shared Plan branch
Retain context across Slices; test-first when useful
Owner returns to main for re-planning
All Ticket Slices implemented + locally checked
Main dispatches separate fresh Sol/high verifier
Executed evidence or concrete N/A reasons
Main coordinator decides Test Quality Gate
Run checks; retain evidence and round count
Only after two consecutive failed repair rounds
Local RED/GREEN runs within the same Slice implementer.
Formal verification covers the whole function, not one agent per Slice.
The Ticket owner retains context across Slices; no per-Slice main acknowledgment.
All workers are leaves and never spawn agents. Main retains design, integration and gates.
Context isolation does not isolate files or shared test state.
Every acceptance criterion needs executed evidence.
Mandatory dimensions pass or have concrete N/A reasons.
Retry or agent replacement cannot erase unexplained flakiness.
The initial implementation failure is not a repair round.
After two failed repair checks for the same problem, stop Luna edits there;
use a fresh Sol/high repair worker. Unrelated development remains Luna-routed.
repaired + locally checked; dispatch new verifier
same problem fails; repair rounds below 2
same problem fails after repair round 2
repaired + locally checked; dispatch new verifier
Sol cannot fix; main diagnoses and replans
